Heard learned counsel appearing for the parties.

In this writ petition, petitioner has sought for a direction to the respondent Nos.2, 3 and 4 to consider the representations of the petitioner produced at Annexures - F, F1 and F2 to the Writ Petition.

3. Having taken note of the submissions made by learned counsel appearing for the parties, since the grievance of the petitioner is with regard to awarding compensation and in that view of the matter, it is open for the petitioner to approach the Reference Court as it is submitted that the respondent - authorities have already deposited the Award amount before the competent court in The Magadi Taluk Agricultural Produce vs The State Of Karnataka on 11 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31303270/
